phase: CD-5 — Candidate Episode, Lifecycle & Cost Context
authority: user GO ruling 2026-10-04 (four sublayers A-D; three hard constraints; completion gate eight conditions frozen now)
three_hard_constraints: (1) candidate/source disappearance must NOT directly terminate episodes
(2) current OHLCV supports only MODEL-DERIVED cost proxies, never claimed as true participant holding cost (no 主力成本/筹码峰/机构成本)
(3) CD-5 describes lifecycle & cost background only, produces NO trading decisions

cd5a_episode_contract_frozen.source_state_series: daily, per stock, three booleans from frozen V2 definitions (T_LONG/T_MID/T_SHORT verbatim, trailing-only)
cd5a_episode_contract_frozen.create: no active episode AND some source flips false->true -> CREATE EPISODE (start_date = that day, origin_source = that source)
cd5a_episode_contract_frozen.add_event: episode active AND a DIFFERENT source flips false->true -> ADD SOURCE EVENT (never a new episode)
cd5a_episode_contract_frozen.source_inactive: source true->false while active: record only; episode continues

termination.INACTIVE_TERMINATION: 40 consecutive sessions with NO source true (episode already active; tracked from last source-true day)
termination.CENSORED: data end 2026-09-30 reached while active — never counted as failure

cd5a_episode_contract_frozen.origin_is_metadata_not_ttl: no uniform episode expiry; L/M/S natural scales already measured in CD-4V2

axes_per_episode_day.rp_sector: stock 20d qfq return minus sector-eq 20d return (sector from csrc_v1)
axes_per_episode_day.rp_market: stock 20d qfq return minus market-eq 20d return
axes_per_episode_day.structure: close vs episode MA60 (ratio); episode drawdown from episode running high (min so far)
axes_per_episode_day.participation_ratio: 20d mean volume / episode-start trailing 20d mean volume (baseline fixed at start)
axes_per_episode_day.cost_position: close vs cost band P25..P75 proxy (below/inside/above), distance to weighted-median center

cd5b_lifecycle_frozen.band_protocol: dev-window (episode-days with start_date <= 2023-12-31) distribution of each continuous axis -> frozen q33/q67; holdout pure application; Support-First census before state freeze

state_synthesis_frozen.priority: DECAYING > STRENGTHENING > HOLDING (checked in this order)
state_synthesis_frozen.STRENGTHENING: (rp_sector OUTPERFORM OR rp_market OUTPERFORM) AND participation not-LOW
state_synthesis_frozen.DECAYING: (rp_sector UNDERPERFORM AND rp_market UNDERPERFORM) AND (cost_position BELOW OR participation LOW)
state_synthesis_frozen.HOLDING: everything else (pullback above cost band with intact participation stays HOLDING — multi-axis requirement is the point)

cd5b_lifecycle_frozen.structural_failure_rule_frozen: close < cost_band_lower (P25 proxy) for 15 consecutive sessions AND participation_ratio < 0.5 -> STRUCTURAL_FAILURE at 15th session
cd5b_lifecycle_frozen.inactive_termination_rule_frozen: 40 consecutive sessions with no source true -> INACTIVE_TERMINATION

cd5c_cost_context_frozen.semantics: Historical Traded-Volume Cost Proxy — model-derived from OHLCV; all fields suffixed/flagged model_derived
cd5c_cost_context_frozen.cost_region: volume-weighted quantiles of episode-period (price_proxy, vol) observations: weighted median=cost_center_proxy, P25/P75=cost_band_lower/upper, weighted IQR=cost_dispersion_proxy
cd5c_cost_context_frozen.volume_below_current_price_ratio: share of episode cumulative volume whose price_proxy < current close — interpretable ONLY as relation of historical traded price locations to current price (ownership/turnover unknown)

cd5d_validation_frozen.sampling: episode-days sampled at: episode start + first session of each ISO week during episode + first entry day into each lifecycle state
outcomes_5_20_60d: P(still STRENGTHENING at horizon | STRENGTHENING now)
P(enters DECAYING or episode STRUCTURAL_FAILURE within horizon)
cd5d_validation_frozen.stratification_hard_requirement: all / L-origin / M-origin / S-origin reported separately; origin-conditional findings kept honestly
cd5d_validation_frozen.purpose: do lifecycle labels carry real TIME-DIRECTION meaning — NOT which state buys best

context_only: sector narrowing flag + market regime carried as context; NARROWING episode-ending is CD-6, NOT here
